description: A resolved config with two trailing zeros in a Decimal: answer_tolerance "0.0100" (exponent -4), numerically the shipped 0.01. The companion of decimal_trailing_zero ("0.010", exponent -3): the config has one Decimal field, so each shape needs its own scenario. Canonical JSON writes a Decimal as its exact string (R0.4.3); a runner that normalised it to "0.01", fully or only for some exponents, fails the hash oracle on one of the two.
exercises: R0.4.3 canonical JSON of a Decimal with two trailing zeros
